# coolify_github_app_repositories (Data Source)

The repositories a GitHub App (`coolify_github_app`) can access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_github_app_repositories" "org" {
  github_app_id = coolify_github_app.org.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `github_app_id` (Number) Numeric id of the GitHub App.

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) Accessible repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `full_name` (String) `owner/repo`.
- `id` (Number) GitHub repository id.
- `name` (String) Repository name.
- `private` (Boolean) Private repository.
